title: Known application URL release registration
description: Register accepts at most 1 MiB JSON and rejects duplicate property names. Rust additionally requires environment to equal the CLI environment, version to contain no double dot, entry HTML under /sub-apps/<selected-known-app>/versions/<version>/, every resource under that same immutable prefix, and distinct resolved resource URLs. Raw and resolved canonical URLs are limited to 2000 characters before binding; the canonical values are sent by guarded register. The CLI --app-code selects work-orders (default) or stores; the JSON field set is unchanged. This registers existing URL resources; it does not install ZIPs, copy files or control Docker.

entryUrl.description: Rust validates HTTP(S), no credentials/query/fragment/whitespace/control/encoded separators or traversal. Relative paths resolve against the release entry; production requires HTTPS. Development HTTP additionally requires the explicit loopback flag and a literal loopback host.
